subject: Private Offer setup — pricing, term length, and buyer-approval routing
messages:
From: Jared Moore <jared.moore@hexacloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Offer questions — term/approval routing

Evelyn / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at HexaCloud is getting our internal approvals lined up and we have a couple of operational questions before we ask finance to sign: 

1) Term length: we'd prefer a 9-month pilot that converts to an annual committed contract if usage exceeds the pilot threshold. Can AWS Marketplace private offers be issued with a 9-month initial term, or do they need to be 12/24 months?

2) Buyer approvals: our legal/finance team wants to know if we can delegate signature to our procurement lead and a named buyer (no CFO signoff) for pilot orders, or if your pricing/activation requires executive approval in the PO flow.

3) Pricing: please confirm if the pilot pricing can be discounted and whether the private offer can lock pricing for the conversion period.

I've attached a short PO draft and our internal requirements. If feasible, we want to move quickly — goal is to sign by end of November.

Attachments: hexacloud_po_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

Cheers,
Jared
Head of Procurement
HexaCloud
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Moore <jared.moore@hexacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions — term/approval routing

Jared —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can structure a 9-month pilot on AWS Marketplace as a private offer (pilot term is supported), and pricing can be set to convert to a fixed annual rate if both parties agree in the PO wording. About approvals — we typically set the buyer role to your procurement owner + one named approver and do not require CFO by default for pilot POs. We will confirm AWS AM requirements but have done delegated-buyer flows before.

I'm attaching our recommended pricing table (pricing_table_v2.csv) and a one-page activation checklist. Proposed next steps: 
- You confirm the two named approvers (procurement lead + buyer)
- We draft the private offer with a 9-month pilot term, conversion clause to a 12-month commitment, and a conversion discount cap
- Vanessa (cc'd) will handle the activation via AWS once the PO is signed

If that works I'll redline the PO and loop in our AWS AM to make sure there are no Marketplace gating items.

Attachments: pricing_table_v2.csv (text/csv)

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

- Term: Offer 9-month pilot (Activation = signature date), with auto-option to convert to 12-month at pre-agreed rates if usage threshold X met.
- Pricing: provide two SKUs: pilot-discount SKU (time-limited) and committed SKU (post-conversion). Use pricing_table_v2.csv to seed the private-offer rates.
- Approvals: set buyer approver list to Proc Lead (Jared) + named Buyer; do NOT require CFO for pilot. Add a legal review clause but keep activation window short (48–72 hours) to prevent stale offers.
- AWS gating: Vanessa, can you confirm whether we need to request buyer approval scopes from AWS AM?

I'll draft the PO redline tonight. Ben — please confirm discount tier viability against our margin targets (Deal DL-2026-3749).

Evelyn
